text:
### Cash Handling  
**Policy:** Cash Handling Procedures (CHP-001)  
- **Daily Cash Limit:** £20,000 per branch
- **Vault Security:** Dual custody (manager + officer)
- **Reconciliation:** Daily EOD
- **Dispute Resolution:** <£1,000 threshold for branch manager approval  
**Armored Transport:** Provided by external contractor (Brinks)
**Collection Schedule:** 3x weekly (Mon, Wed, Fri)

raw_entities.name: Cash Handling Procedures
raw_entities.description: Policy governing daily cash handling operations across branches, including limits, security protocols, and reconciliation requirements. Establishes the framework for cash management and dispute resolution thresholds.

raw_entities.name: Daily Cash Limit per Branch
raw_entities.description: Maximum cash holding permitted at each branch location on a daily basis. This limit is enforced as part of cash handling procedures.

raw_entities.name: Vault Security Dual Custody Requirement
raw_entities.description: Security control mandating that vault access and cash handling require two authorized personnel — a manager and an officer — to be present simultaneously. This dual custody arrangement mitigates fraud and theft risk.

raw_entities.name: Daily End-of-Day Cash Reconciliation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory daily reconciliation of cash holdings at end of business day (EOD) to ensure accuracy and detect discrepancies. Part of the Cash Handling Procedures policy.

raw_entities.name: Branch Manager Dispute Resolution Approval Threshold
raw_entities.description: Decision authority permitting branch managers to approve dispute resolution for cash discrepancies below £1,000 without escalation. Disputes at or above this threshold require higher-level approval.
context: Dispute Resolution: <£1,000 threshold for branch manager approval

raw_entities.name: Brinks Armored Transport Service
raw_entities.description: External contractor responsible for secure armored transport of cash to and from branch locations. Operates on a scheduled collection basis three times per week.
context: Armored Transport: Provided by external contractor (Brinks)

raw_entities.name: Armored Transport Collection Frequency
raw_entities.description: Schedule for cash collection by armored transport service, occurring three times per week on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Ensures regular removal of excess cash from branch locations.
